scope: A04 only; fixed 38980 English articles; no word minimum or duplicate exclusions

split.P_identity: SHA256 of saved P prose-unit texts joined in unit_index order with two newlines; nonempty text only, not lexical-word hashes
split.components: known numeric authors joined transitively when nonempty P hashes match; all years included; unknown authors not assigned to either group
split.component_key: minimum numeric DEV author ID, formatted dev:user:<id>
split.assignment: SHA256('42:vocab:'+component_key), first byte <128 => discovery, otherwise holdout
split.leakage_limit: exact nonempty P only; near duplicates not addressed

tokens.basis: saved T02 ASCII word values lowercased, no stemming or stopword removal
tokens.boundaries: P/L: no crossing owner, sentence, source prose unit, or any non-word token (URL/email/identifier/number/Unicode word); punctuation inside a sentence is not itself a break; H: heading boundary and non-word token breaks
tokens.domains: P discovery; selected candidates also counted in P/L/H after freeze; unknown authors only full descriptive tables

discovery.eligibility_scope: pooled six main-comparison years in discovery, each article counted once; distinct authors across years
discovery.safe_prefilter: at least20 occurrences in main years is necessary for20 documents; then exact document/author thresholds
discovery.main_estimate: article document frequency within each year (zero-P articles retained), equal mean of annual rates; post minus pre
discovery.ratio: post annual-equal frequency / pre frequency; zero pre => NA, not infinity or a ranking key
discovery.rank: absolute document-frequency difference descending, ties shorter n then lexical term; positive and negative separately

rare.selection: all eligible terms satisfying rules, no cap; separately labelled

classification.note: fixed lexical proxies, not semantic ground truth; no dictionary editing based on holdout

holdout.opened_after: candidate manifest and discovery selection rules sealed
holdout.outcome: same_direction if nonzero discovery and holdout differences have same sign; opposite_direction otherwise; exact zero labelled zero; not a significance or equivalence test
holdout.minimums: report all selected candidates; scarcity and NA retained, do not relax thresholds
holdout.uncertainty: conditional component-cluster percentile intervals for holdout document-frequency differences; known author components, no p-values/BH tests

bootstrap.lexical_unit: all holdout components across2018-2025 sampled together, all their articles retained
bootstrap.diversity_unit: all known individual authors across2018-2025 sampled together, as previous tasks

author_spread: annual and period known-author prevalence, document hits per using author, occurrence share of top1/top5 authors, and mean per-author article prevalence; period denominators kept explicit, unequal period lengths not posting-frequency comparisons

strata.topic_map: t02-strata-map.json, first matching priority, absent/unmapped tags =>unknown; article type not used
strata.eligible_comparison: at least20 articles and10 known authors in each of six comparison years; otherwise NA delta with counts preserved

diversity: reuse sealed MATTR100/50 values and NA; article-equal annual summaries, length bands, full and known-author point/author-cluster intervals; no recomputation of T02
interpretation: CC-saved conditional vocabulary differences only; no AI use-rate or causal inference
